regional_test: two-sided signed-rank on finite patient effects
Core47: Tier A and composition-balanced effect >0 and BH<0.05
Spatial43: Core47 and Moran median>0 and Moran BH<0.05 and positive tumour/stroma fraction>=5/6
Convergent9: Spatial43 and (COREAD-preferential dependency or DNA top30 bootstrap frequency>=0.8)
Extended13: Spatial43 and (COREAD-preferential dependency or DNA driver/CNA frequency>=0.05)
visual_score_missing_components: mean of available z scores; no imputation
historical_null_reproduction: retained vectors; original set iteration order unavailable
raw_new_null_order: sorted target/background genes; fresh deterministic draws
